Subject: Summary (final) — AlphaTech order form commercial changes for legal handoff

Following the call and the internal sprint, here's a concise handoff pack for Legal & Finance. Please review and confirm before I send the final clean Order Form to AlphaTech via DocuSign.

Key negotiated concessions / agreed language (high level):
- Minimum commit: accepted 60% Year 1 / 40% Year 2. No unit price change; instead we will apply a one-time allocation note in Appendix A to describe recognition and reporting.
- Net terms: agreed Net45; invoices will be issued monthly with a PO number required on each invoice; invoicing cut-date aligned to the last business day of the month.
- Invoice routing: Redwood will issue invoices to the billed entity specified by AlphaTech on the PO. Order Form will include a Billing Entity table (columns: Service Scope | Bill To Entity | Country | Tax ID).
- VAT / Reverse-charge: for EU invoices, apply reverse-charge where applicable. Customer must provide VAT registration evidence prior to first EU invoice.
- Withholding: customer may withhold taxes where required by local law. Redwood will accept withholding provided a valid withholding certificate is supplied within 30 days; Redwood will issue a credit note to reconcile gross vs net amounts per standard tax evidence template.
- Early termination / proration: no change to cap; proration formula inserted in Appendix A (see attached redlines).

Attachments to include in handoff: redlines_20261204.pdf; AlphaTech_PO_template.pdf; tax_evidence_template.xlsx (I have attached the first two here; will add the tax template once Karhtik confirms wording).

Next steps (legal & finance):

- aditya.rao: once legal confirms, please sign-off accounting treatment for the allocation note so we can finalize Appendix A.
- laura.bennett: once legal + finance sign-off, I will upload the clean Order Form to DocuSign and route to David/Procurement.

If there are no objections, I will ship to DocuSign noon PT tomorrow 12/08.
